boundary_condition: 适用于跨团队交付场景，单 PM 自研项目可弱化此步骤

boundary_condition: 适用于没有历史数据的 New Product Launch

validation_criteria: Success Metrics 节包含 Current Goal 表格且未填值项有 Open Question 标签

boundary_condition: 快速模式可跳过 Gate，但需标注 Design basis incomplete
